lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Peace survives because disciplined operators stand between ordinary families and raider violence.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Your assault frame is tuned. Kell is already pretending he did not hear the speech.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: I heard it. I simply did not learn anything.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Hollowmere perimeter. Routine anti-raider work. We finish clean.

lines.speaker: government
lines.text: Two armed emplacements protect a raider logistics compound. Destroy both.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Hollowmere is listed as agricultural territory.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: Intelligence still calls it a stronghold.

options.text: Turrets only. Nothing else gets shot.
options.spokenText: Turrets only. Nothing else gets shot.
Follow the target packet exactly. No deviations.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: A major raider fortress has fallen through Chancellor Aldric’s decisive leadership.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: That package has aerial footage, casualty numbers, and a victory speech. We ended the fight less than a minute ago.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: No mobile defenders. No supply train. No proper firing positions.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: You broke the old security guns and called us raiders.

lines.speaker: civilian
lines.text: You said you were protecting people. Look at the transports.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Save the raw combat record. Nobody edits our copy.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Pull back. Whatever command told us, these people are not an army.

midBattle.speaker: government
midBattle.text: Targets marked. Destroy both raider emplacements.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: That armor is agricultural-security grade. Raiders do not bolt these to irrigation concrete.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Barely any armor. This was built to scare thieves, not stop a lance.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Those are passenger haulers. Families, Commander—not troop carriers.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Both guns down. No raider vehicles, no ammunition stores, no fighting positions. This was never a stronghold.
